name: The Boats' Lantern
description: A ship's lantern, its glass smoked brown, that hung at the bow of the first boat over from Cindermoor the night of the Snuffing. While the chapter waited, old Brother Anselm, who rowed that boat, carried it out past the candle wall and stood in the fog with it till it went cold and silver. It holds Kindleby's night of the boats: the lanterns along the quay, every face that came up the steps out of the dark, and whatever the ones who came over saw, and have not slept for since. The chapter's choice. A Remnant, made on purpose.
